notes.title: 🔧 [ZOMVIRUS Update News] Standard Gun Control System! 🔧
notes.content: [p]Hello, fellow survivors.[/p][p]This is the ZOMVIRUS development team.[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we're announcing major overhauls to the gun control system, which has been a long-standing topic of user feedback.[/p][p]As this is an element that determines the feel and immersion of combat, we've meticulously reviewed each aspect based on your feedback.[/p][p]We're currently working on a major overhaul to ensure a more immersive and stable combat experience in the VR environment.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]1. Improved Gun Control Sensitivity and Shake[/p][p]One of the most frequently reported issues we've received is feedback like, "My hands shake even when I'm quiet, making it difficult to aim," and "When I add a gun, it becomes too much fun and breaks the immersion."[/p][p][/p][p]Issue:[/p][p]- Previously, unnecessary shaking of the hand and gun even when standing still made aiming difficult and inconvenient.[/p][p][/p][p]Solution:[/p][p]- This revision improves hand position stability, ensuring the gun remains naturally stable even when standing still.[/p][p]- We've reduced unnecessary gun shaking in VR environments, allowing for smoother, more precise firing.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/ccdb56c0f7c353af6a15c47c967c0bf673934cc3.gif"][/img][/p][p]2. Improved Gun Grab System Flexibility[/p][p]We received feedback that the previous system felt unnatural, with players experiencing awkward gripping of the gun, their hands flicking when gripping it with both hands, and inaccurate loading.[/p][p]The following improvements have been made to provide a more natural and flexible control experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Improvements:[/p][p]- The grab points have been completely redesigned to more intuitively grasp various parts of the gun, including the handle, magazine, and slide.[/p][p]- We've reduced the apparent stuttering when firing with both hands, allowing for a smoother grip.[/p][p]- Improved magazine ejection and reloading methods have enhanced the physical response when grabbing and reloading the magazine, providing a more realistic feel for the actual weapon.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/d3a786b9e9181bc8116ca5bf2cfcca5581f7998a.gif"][/img][/p][p]3. Firearm Recoil Renewal[/p][p]We received feedback that the recoil felt too strong or unnatural when firing firearms, resulting in a lackluster shooting experience.[/p][p]In response to this feedback, we have adjusted the recoil values and recoil animations for all weapons to be more realistic.[/p][p][/p][p]Improvements:[/p][p]- We are currently applying recoil that matches the unique characteristics of each weapon, such as pistols and rifles.[/p][p]- We have improved the reaction time and position return speed of the hand recoil after firing, providing a more realistic impact feel.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/f4e11dd95dc948ca2894c6fb5e225388d90cc50d.gif"][/img][/p][p]4. Planned Introduction of Two-Handed Pistol Grab Feature[/p][p]- Currently a feature in internal testing, we plan to officially introduce two-handed pistol grab functionality in the next update.[/p][p]- We are currently in the final testing phase and will be introducing it soon in an update.[/p][p][/p][p]At ZOMVIRUS, your feedback is of the utmost importance to us.[/p][p]We will continue to make steady improvements to further enhance the immersion and realism of gameplay.[/p][p]Please report any bugs or suggest improvements through the official Discord or Steam message boards.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]The Dream of the ZOMVIRUS Development Team[/p]

notes.title: Introducing the 'ZOMVIRUS'
notes.content:
◎ Overview  
*ZOMVIRUS* is a first-person zombie apocalypse survival action game set in Seoul, South Korea. Players start in a quarantined zone filled with zombies and journey toward their designated safe area, encountering various storylines along the way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/38f1176511f76e62d2cc7509552cfc68b9828012.png[/img]

◎ Genre  
*ZOMVIRUS* is a VR-exclusive, PvE-focused zombie apocalypse survival action game. As the lone survivor in a zombie-ravaged Hongdae, players must use available weapons and supplies to escape the quarantined zone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/01f4b8991102591ed4d446b6ac1e13dc22fc15c6.png[/img]

◎ Core Fun  
The core thrill of the game lies in surviving among powerful and fast-paced, algorithm-driven Korean zombies by utilizing weapons and supplies to make it out alive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/9f028e79a5e2eff775b50960ce3df2fbd07fb097.png[/img]

◎ Features  
Unlike other similar games, *ZOMVIRUS* immerses players in the real-world setting of Hongdae, one of Korea’s iconic tourist areas.

- Immersive VR Environment  
  Players experience a heightened sense of realism, as gameplay requires operational precision. Rather than using basic FPS-style controls on PC or mobile, players grip and reload weapons with one or both hands, simulating real handling for enhanced immersion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/1268cb0360e718e65435fc450310777189d2b338.png[/img]

- Variety of Korean-Style Weapons
  Following the global collapse triggered by the zombie outbreak, the Korean government quickly shut down high-risk zones and supplied survivors with firearms for self-defense, allowing them to use weapons like the M1 carbine, M16, as well as Korean-specific rifles like the K2 and K5.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/02162ba063a5a5b66ca7688432f6bde27b05f1b5.png[/img]

- Fast and Powerful Korean Zombies
  Zombie hosts in *ZOMVIRUS* actively seek out new environments for propagation. These zombies rely on sight and sound, with heightened auditory sensitivity. Players can avoid detection by sight, but any loud noise attracts zombies from all directions. Inspired by Korean zombie portrayals in *Kingdom* and *All of Us Are Dead*, *ZOMVIRUS* features fast, strong Korean zombies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/3b41c11391bb9a70610b78858438576b7f923335.png[/img]


◎ Development Progress  
Since the project’s initiation in May 2024, development has expanded to capture an ultra-realistic experience throughout the Hongdae area in Seoul and beyond. With an early access version in the works, developers are incorporating user feedback from various events to enhance the gaming experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45267902/ef322008906dab4a176f77c90fb80e475423289b.png[/img]


◎ Future Plans  
Future updates will include bug fixes, optimizations, new scenarios, maps, and potentially a multiplayer mode. Stay tuned for zombie-quarantined cities like Manhattan and Shanghai. Engage with *ZOMVIRUS* through fan pages and feedback boards—your participation aids in reclaiming zombie-infested cities.
